entities.summary: Fatim-Zahra Ammor or Fatima-Zahra Ammor is a Moroccan engineer, consultant and politician. She has served as Minister of Tourism, Handicrafts and Social and Solidarity Economy of Morocco since her appointment on 7 October 2021.
